query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM submission_results AS rs
            INNER JOIN quizzes AS q
            ON rs.sub_quiz_id = q.qz_id
            WHERE
                rs.sub_user_id = $1 AND
                q.qz_title ILIKE $2 AND
                (rs.sub_is_passed = TRUE OR 1 = $3) AND
                q.qz_difficulty = $4
